workouts.title: Compromised Running
workouts.notes: Run splits should stay within 10 s of each other. If round 4 is 20 s+ slower, you went out too hot.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.details:
500 m easy row
2 rounds: 10 air squats, 10 walking lunges, 5 inchworms, 10 band pull-aparts
3 × 20 s strides building to race pace

blocks.title: Strength — Back Squat
blocks.details:
3 s lowering, drive up hard
Build to your working weight, then hit every set
Log what you lifted — next week is calculated from it

blocks.title: Compromised Runs
blocks.details:
1 km run @ HYROX race pace
20 wall balls (9 kg / 6 kg)
15 cal SkiErg
Goal: hold the same run split every round

blocks.title: Cool-down
blocks.details:
Easy walk 3 min
Couch stretch 1 min / side
Pigeon 1 min / side

workouts.title: Threshold + Sled Work
workouts.notes: Threshold = "comfortably hard". You should only manage 3–4 words at a time.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.details:
5 min easy SkiErg
Hip airplanes, world’s greatest stretch
2 × 10 m light sled push + pull

blocks.title: Sled Skill
blocks.details:
15 m sled push (race weight +10%)
15 m sled pull, hand-over-hand
Low hips, short choppy steps, arms locked

blocks.title: Threshold Row
blocks.details:
Pace you could hold for ~20 min
Damper 5–6, rate 26–30
Log your fastest 1000 m

blocks.title: Accessory
blocks.details:
12 single-arm DB rows / side
30 s hollow hold
10 Copenhagen plank lifts / side

workouts.title: Aerobic Base
workouts.notes: Easy means easy. This session builds the engine that makes Friday possible.

blocks.title: Zone 2 Flush
blocks.details:
15 min run
15 min SkiErg
15 min run
Optional: 15 min row
Nasal breathing only — 60–70% max HR

blocks.title: Mobility
blocks.details:
90/90 hip switches 2 × 10
Thoracic openers 2 × 8 / side
Calf + ankle rocks 2 × 15
Deep squat hold 2 × 60 s

workouts.title: Strength Endurance
workouts.notes: Lunges: back knee touches the floor every rep — no-reps in the race cost time.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.details:
1 km easy jog
Glute bridges 2 × 15
Lateral band walks 2 × 10 / side

blocks.title: Strength — Deadlift
blocks.details:
Brace, push the floor away
Same weight across all sets
Log what you lifted — next week is calculated from it

blocks.title: Station Grind
blocks.details:
50 m sandbag lunges (20 kg / 10 kg)
100 m farmers carry (2 × 24 kg / 2 × 16 kg)
20 burpee broad jumps
400 m run

blocks.title: Finisher — 1 km Time Trial
blocks.details:
Run 1 km as fast as you can on tired legs
This is your "compromised 1 km" benchmark

workouts.title: Half HYROX Simulation
workouts.notes: Treat this like race day: same shoes, same fuel, same warm-up. Use a voice note to tell me where you lost time.

blocks.title: Warm-up
blocks.details:
800 m easy run
2 rounds: 250 m Ski, 250 m row, 5 burpee broad jumps
2 × 100 m strides

blocks.title: Half Simulation
blocks.details:
1 km run + 1000 m SkiErg
1 km run + 50 m sled push
1 km run + 50 m sled pull
1 km run + 80 m burpee broad jumps
Record total time and each station split

blocks.title: Cool-down
blocks.details:
Easy walk + full-body stretch
Refuel within 60 min

voiceNotes.transcript: Felt really strong today. Smashed the wall balls unbroken and I think I got a PB on the 1k, legs felt fresh the whole way.

summary.headline: Felt really strong today.
summary.coachAction: Celebrate the win publicly — great moment to reinforce momentum.

voiceNotes.transcript: Struggled a bit today, got a twinge of pain in my left knee on the lunges so I scaled the last round. Not sure if I should run tomorrow.
